title: FDSI Global Aliases Index
description: Schema for the generated flat alias -> canonical icon map used for agent grep-based bulk renames. Intended to be produced by a future build script from each icon's meta.json aliases array; the current file under registry/generated is a hand-authored sample.

canonical.description: Current canonical icon name the alias resolves to.

path.description: Repo-relative path to the canonical icon's folder.
